sentences.en: Ecology is the study of living things all around us.
sentences.zh: 生态学是研究我们周围所有生物的科学。

sentences.en: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
sentences.zh: 污染对地区的生态环境有灾难性的影响。

sentences.en: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
sentences.zh: 就是在他的影响下，她才对生态产生了兴趣。

senses.zh: 生态学；社会生态学 形容词: ecological
